build_rec_roi_head: build a RecRoIHead instance with use_group_mask and stop_grad_group config options
run_forward_train: run forward training pass for RecRoIHead with proposals, ground truth bboxes, labels, and masks
test_simple_test_bboxes: test bounding box detection using RecRoIHead simple_test_bboxes with proposals and image metadata
test_simple_test_mask: test mask prediction using RecRoIHead simple_test_mask with detected bboxes and labels
run_merge_results: run merge_results to combine detected bboxes, labels, segmentation results, and NMS indices
